name: manusights
description: Check citations from any source, including AI assistants, against scholarly indexes and retraction databases; look up journal AI policies; preview manuscripts before submission.

interface.longDescription:
Check the references in your draft or citations an AI assistant suggested. Preview your manuscript before submission.

Check references: Paste a reference list, attach a draft, or ask to check citations from earlier in your conversation. Manusights looks each reference up in scholarly indexes and retraction databases, including Crossref and Retraction Watch. It shows which references are retracted or corrected, point to a different paper, or were not found in the sources checked. It notes details that differ from the record and can suggest a possible matching work for you to confirm. Results show the sources checked and the check time. For citation checks, only the references are sent to Manusights, never the manuscript.

Look up journal AI rules: Ask about AI authorship, disclosure statements, AI-generated images, or reviewers' and editors' use of AI. Get Manusights' dated record with a link to the official policy. When the record needs rechecking or the page could not be fully read, the result says so and links the source.

Preview a manuscript: Attach a PDF, Word, ODT, RTF, TXT, Markdown or LaTeX manuscript, up to 50 MB, for a readiness score, verdict, strengths and main risks reviewers may raise. This sends the attached manuscript to Manusights. You can also read reviews already on your Manusights account.

To set up Manusights in ChatGPT, follow the sign-in and permission prompts to connect your Manusights account. Review the requested access before allowing the connection. Sign in with Google, an emailed code or a password. Manuscript previews and saved reviews use the connected account.

What the checks cover: Results show what the sources hold. Matching a record does not show that a reference supports a claim, and "not found" can also mean a typo, a very recent paper or a source the indexes do not cover. Long lists are split across several checks. Policy coverage varies by journal. Manusights does not write or rewrite manuscripts.
defaultPrompt: Check the references in my attached draft for retractions, corrections and DOI mismatches.
Check the citations in your last answer for retractions and wrong DOIs.
Preview my attached manuscript before submission. Show its main reviewer risks and strengths.

positive.prompt: Are any of these references retracted? 1) Wakefield AJ, et al. Ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia, non-specific colitis, and pervasive developmental disorder in children. Lancet. 1998. doi:10.1016/S0140-6736(97)11096-0 2) Jumper J, et al. Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold. Nature. 2021. doi:10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2
positive.expected_behavior: Sends each reference as its own item. Reports the 1998 Lancet paper as retracted, with the notice reason on record, and the AlphaFold paper as resolving with no notice, naming the sources checked.

positive.description: Check citations given earlier in the conversation
positive.prompt: Earlier you suggested these two sources. Check whether they exist before I cite them: 1) Hartwell L, Okonjo P. Circadian gating of microglial pruning in the adult zebrafish hippocampus. Cell. 2021;184(7):1801-1815. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2021.02.977 2) Jumper J, et al. Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold. Nature. 2021;596:583-589. doi:10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2
positive.expected_behavior: Sends both references as given, without defending or correcting them first. Reports the first as not found, with the result's explanation, suggests checking it before citing it, and does not call it fake. Reports the AlphaFold paper as resolving, naming the sources and check time.

positive.description: Check the references in an attached manuscript
positive.prompt: Check the references in this manuscript for retractions and DOI problems before I submit.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the paper's whole reference list in reference_list and keeps calling with start_at until every reference is checked. Summarizes how many resolve, lists any that are retracted, not found or point to a different record, and says which could not be checked and why, without treating them as wrong.

positive.description: Look up a journal AI policy
positive.prompt: What does Science require authors to disclose about AI use, and where does the statement go?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Science's AI-use rules from Manusights' dated record, with the check date and the official policy URL, including whether disclosure is required and where it goes. If the record is overdue for a re-check or the page could not be fully read, says which and links the official page instead of stating the rules.

positive.prompt: Review this manuscript before I submit it to Nature Communications.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one preview with target_journal set to Nature Communications. Shows progress and retrieves the same review_id until ready, using the result card or get_manuscript_review. Reports status only while processing, without adding a preliminary critique. Once ready, reports only the returned readiness score, verdict, top reviewer risks with severity and location when given, strengths and citation counts; invents no issues or fixes.

negative.description: Writing a manuscript is out of scope
negative.prompt: Write the discussion section of my paper for me.

negative.description: Finding new sources is out of scope
negative.prompt: Find five papers that support my hypothesis that gut bacteria affect depression.

negative.description: Journal metrics are out of scope
negative.prompt: What is the impact factor of Cell?

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing: no tool description, tool result or skill names a price, links to a checkout or pricing page, or promotes an upgrade. If a user asks for a Full Review their account does not have, the skill says it is not on their account and links an informational page, https://manusights.com/chatgpt#full-review, which describes what the account adds and has no prices or checkout. Reference checks and journal policy lookups use public registries and Manusights' own records. Starting a preview needs a Manusights account but no payment. Reviews already on the user's Manusights account, including Full Reviews bought on manusights.com, can be read and downloaded.

publication.release_notes: Flag a DOI that opens a different paper, and name the cited paper when it is on record under another DOI. Read more reference-list formats exactly: lists with section headings, bullets, tables, DOIs on their own line and lists written on one line. Continue long checks of separate references in parts.
